name: webshop-lab metrics v1
status: definition only; contains no model result

success.note: done means the episode ended with a purchase. A purchase with a wrong product/specification or an exceeded budget still ends the episode, often with reward 0, so it is not success.

denominators.success_rate: episodes: every record in the JSONL, failures included
denominators.invalid_action_rate: steps: every recorded step; an invalid action still consumes a step

metrics.name: full_reward_successes
metrics.definition: episodes with done == true and final_reward >= 1 - 1e-6

metrics.name: success_rate_ci95
metrics.definition: 95% interval for success_rate (method depends on repeats)

metrics.name: mean_final_reward
metrics.definition: mean of final_reward over all episodes

metrics.name: episodes_with_invalid_actions
metrics.definition: episodes containing at least one ungrounded step

metrics.name: termination_counts
metrics.definition: counts of purchase and max_steps terminations

uncertainty.repeated_tasks: task-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 42; never treat repeated trajectories as independent samples
uncertainty.paired_runs: McNemar exact test on discordant tasks plus a paired task-cluster bootstrap (comparison.py)

failure_counting.counts: one primary label per failed episode
failure_counting.any_counts: episodes where the signal appears as primary or secondary label
failure_counting.why_primary_is_the_purchase_outcome: a purchase with reward 0 would otherwise be hidden behind format errors

out_of_scope: no per-seed aggregation; multiple seeds are separate runs
no significance claim for a single pair of runs without the paired interval
no success claim from upstream demo trajectories
